model.summary: Model favors PHI by 0.3 points (51% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (NYG +1.6), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (NYG +1.4), Quarterback rating (PHI +1.1). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.
